channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: At least 6 killed in fire at apartment block in Belgium’s Antwerp
item.description: Firefighters battle blaze that has also injured a number of people in Linkeroever area of Antwerp.

item.title: Russian attacks kill three in Ukraine as Kyiv hits another oil refinery
item.description: President Zelenskyy says Ukraine is expanding its long-range drone campaign with new strikes deep inside Russia.

item.title: US-Iran negotiations: What’s the latest?
item.description: Iranian officials are expected in Doha for talks with Qatari mediators, a day after US negotiators arrived there.

item.title: Pakistan says it intercepted four drones fired from Afghanistan
item.description: Afghan defence ministry says it carried out 'air strikes' in Pakistan's Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces.

item.title: US envoys in Doha to meet mediators but not Iranians, Qatar says
item.description: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman says no high-level meetings or direct talks between the US and Iran are scheduled.

item.title: Rescuers keep up search for survivors at collapsed La Guaira building
item.description: At least 1,700 people are known to have been killed in the disaster but hope remains that others can continue to be found alive.
